title: Metal Slug: Awakening

anticheat.note: Two of the game's threads stop on a breakpoint right after it starts and it never shows a window (highball-db#807). ProtonDB rates it poor on Linux too.

provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#807, 2026-10-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 1 of 5: no window after 35 minutes. Their log shows metal_slug_launcher.exe starting, then two threads ending on breakpoint exceptions (0x80000003) at the same address, Wine's debugger starting, and nothing after. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Does not start. Its launcher runs, then the game stops on a breakpoint, which is how Tencent's Anti-Cheat Expert refuses to run. It fails the same way on Linux.
